text:
Leah (CEO): Opening this thread to capture the live Q&A follow-ups from today: what patterns explain recent wins/losses and what immediate asks should we surface to Product/Legal/Eng? Keep replies short—just actions or signals.

Tara (Sales): Field recap: wins = retailers (ecom) and adops. Key win drivers: predictable p95, simple migration path from other vendors, and clear cost modeling. Losses = HealthTech and Gov for data residency and audit log depth.

Ethan (Solutions): Adding detail: Ecom win was a lift-and-shift using our Dedicated staging runbook + our caching suggestions. They reported 40% cheaper token cost vs their old provider after we tuned batching.

Rina (Product): Thanks. Can we prioritize a small set of deliverables we can commit to in the next 30 days? Example: 1) migration playbook template 2) audit-readiness one-pager 3) per-route SLA language draft.

Lewis (Legal): Drafting contract language for audit logs and retention is doable but needs precise retention windows and incident reporting SLAs. If Prod wants templates, give us target retention values (e.g., 30/60/90 days).

Carmen (CS): Customers want a single PDF that procurement can hand to legal. Also hearing asks for a sample SOC2 Evidence bundle (redacted). Can we collect a POA for that?

Ilya (Eng): Eng notes: data residency -> needs region pinning + private endpoint options. Audit logs: we can extend retention, but cost and storage architecture need estimates. For migration playbook, here's a short snippet we use internally:

```
Migration playbook (summary):
- Pre-checks: model size, peak qps, pinned region
- Staging: Dedicated pool + traffic mirror 10%
- Perf tuning: enable batching, prefix caching, measure p95
- Cutover: weighted rollout 10/30/60/100
- Post: measure token cost delta and user-facing latency
```

Tara (Sales): That playbook is perfect to include in the sales kit. Request: add a one-line "cost delta" example (e.g., "~30% cost reduction vs X under config Y").

Leah (CEO): Action owners: Rina to own migration playbook + 1-pager; Lewis to own contract language; Ilya to scope engineering effort for retention/region pinning. Carmen + Tara to collect customer examples and sample SOC2 artifacts. Can we get rough estimates by next Tue?

ops-bot: New task created: ENG-2298 "Audit log retention scoping" assigned to Ilya. Link: https://redwood.internal/tasks/ENG-2298

Ilya (Eng): I'll take ENG-2298. Quick ask: do we plan to provide tiered retention in-product or as an enterprise add-on? That affects implementation.

Rina (Product): Prefer tiered retention as a paid option (discuss pricing) but will scope for both.

Lewis (Legal): I'll draft 2 variants of SLA text (one for standard hosted, one for Dedicated/Private) and drop them here when ready.

Carmen (CS): I'll gather 2 anonymized SOC2 proof bundles and upload to the task.

Tara (Sales): I'll add 3 short "why we won" blurbs for the sales playbook (will post by EOD).

Leah (CEO): Great cadence. If anyone has additional signals (procurement redlines, specific competitor objections), drop them here. Closing the loop after estimates are in. :white_check_mark:
